items.title: Nvidia's Huang scandal rattles AI industry built around him

items.title: Did Jensen Huang know? Nvidia's CEO and an alleged spy
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has admitted to an affair with Alice Huang, a Megaspeed executive US intelligence believes was recruited by China. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down her alleged goal of loosening AI chip export controls, the classified memo, Nvidia's board investigation, why Commerce didn't act and whether Jensen knew.
